dict.Notița nu are rânduri de bifat (☐). Pune: The note has no checklist lines (☐). Add them with the ☐ To Do button, then try again.
dict.Rândurile de bifat (☐ / ☑) ca sarcini în: The checklist lines (☐ / ☑) as tasks in an .ics file: e-mail and calendar programs put them in their task list; the note's reminder becomes the due date
